events.title: Green Velvet (USA)
events.description: Green Velvet, house music legend and the icon behind tracks such as 'La La Land', 'Percolator' and 'Flash', brings his hypnotic tech-house to Brisbane's The Tivoli this September. Shaping dance floors since the early '90s, he remains one of the genre's most electric performers. A true pioneer of house music.  One night only.

events.title: 1974 AD (NEPAL) Pop-Up Ko Yatra
events.description: Formed in Kathmandu in the early 1990s, 1974 AD is one of Nepal's most iconic and successful rock bands. Renowned for their unique fusion of traditional Nepali folk music with western rock, blues and jazz, the band blends native and western instruments to create a sound that is both distinctive and timeless. events.title: Nouvelle Vague (FRA)
events.description: The unmistakably French, effortlessly chic, and refreshingly modern Nouvelle Vague finally returns for three exclusive Australian Shows! Nouvelle Vague breathes new life into beloved tracks by Joy Division, Buzzcocks, The Cure, The Clash, Depeche Mode, The Dead Kennedys and more. events.title: Ezra Collective (UK) With Tash LC
events.description: For more than a decade, Ezra Collective have stood at the forefront of a new movement in British music. Emerging from London's vibrant and ever-evolving jazz underground, the five-piece have become one of the most celebrated and influential bands of their generation, forging a sound that seamlessly bridges jazz, afrobeat, hip-hop, reggae, soul and dance music.Their rise has been nothing short of extraordinary.
